name: google-play-vitals-mcp

tools.name: play_check_status
tools.description: Verify Google Play API dependencies, GCP Service Account credentials, and environment readiness.

credentials_path.description: Optional path to GCP service account JSON key file.

package_name.description: Optional target Android package name to verify.

tools.name: play_get_release_tracks
tools.description: [Release Discovery] Fetch Google Play release tracks (PRODUCTION, BETA, ALPHA, INTERNAL) and active serving releases with their release names and versionCodes. Essential for automatically discovering the latest production version.

package_name.description: Android package name (e.g. com.example.app). Optional if GOOGLE_PLAY_PACKAGE_NAME is set.

credentials_path.description: Optional path to GCP credentials JSON.

tools.name: play_search_error_issues
tools.description: [Atomic Issue Cluster Search] Search Google Play error clusters (CRASH, ANR, or NON_FATAL) with full AIP-160 filter support. Filter by specific versionCode, user-perceived state, or process state (FOREGROUND/BACKGROUND). Sorted by user impact and occurrences.

package_name.description: Android package name. Optional if environment variable is set.

is_user_perceived.description: Optional filter to match only user-perceived error issues.

app_process_state.description: Optional filter for app process state.

page_size.description: Number of top error clusters to retrieve (default: 10, max: 50).

page_token.description: Optional pagination token from previous call.

credentials_path.description: Optional path to GCP credentials JSON.

tools.name: play_get_error_reports
tools.description: [Atomic Error Reports & Stack Traces] Fetch detailed multi-device sample reports and cleaned de-obfuscated stack traces for a given error issue ID or resource name.

issue_id.description: Error issue ID (e.g. 'd6f045ccd040889d') or full resource name ('apps/.../errorIssues/...').

package_name.description: Android package name. Optional if environment variable is set.

page_size.description: Number of sample reports to retrieve (default: 3).

page_token.description: Optional pagination token from previous call.

credentials_path.description: Optional path to GCP credentials JSON.

tools.name: play_list_anomalies
tools.description: [Anomaly Detection] List production metric anomalies and sudden regression spikes detected by Google Play algorithms for the application.

package_name.description: Android package name. Optional if environment variable is set.

page_token.description: Optional pagination token from previous call.

credentials_path.description: Optional path to GCP credentials JSON.

tools.name: play_list_accessible_apps
tools.description: [Account Apps Discovery] List all Google Play applications accessible by the configured GCP Service Account.

page_token.description: Optional pagination token from previous call.

credentials_path.description: Optional path to GCP credentials JSON.

tools.name: play_get_top_anr_summary
tools.description: [One-shot Diagnosis] Retrieve top ANR error clusters along with affected user counts, occurrence rates, and representative cleaned main-thread stack traces. Eliminates back-and-forth round trips.

package_name.description: Android package name (e.g., com.example.app). Optional if GOOGLE_PLAY_PACKAGE_NAME is set.

limit.description: Number of top ANR clusters to retrieve (default: 5).

credentials_path.description: Optional path to GCP credentials JSON.

tools.name: play_get_metric_trends
tools.description: [Token-efficient Metrics] Query trends and daily averages for ANR rate, slow cold start rate (Baseline Profile verification), or Crash rate. Redundant Protobuf metadata is stripped.

metric_type.description: Metric category: 'ANR' (Application Not Responding), 'STARTUP' (Slow cold start rate for Baseline Profile evaluation), or 'CRASH' (Fatal crash rate).

package_name.description: Android package name. Optional if environment variable is set.

days.description: Number of past days to query (default: 7).

credentials_path.description: Optional path to GCP credentials JSON.

tools.name: play_compare_versions
tools.description: [Version Comparison] Compare metrics between two app versions (e.g., before and after Baseline Profile / ANR fixes). Automatically calculates delta and percentage improvement.

package_name.description: Android package name. Optional if environment variable is set.

credentials_path.description: Optional path to GCP credentials JSON.

tools.name: play_get_raw_error_reports
tools.description: [Deep-dive Drilldown] Fetch multi-device environmental samples and full stack traces for a specific error issue ID.

page_size.description: Number of sample reports to retrieve (default: 3).

credentials_path.description: Optional path to GCP credentials JSON.
